statement: Russia and Ukraine carry out at least one prisoner exchange, with prisoners physically transferred, between 2026-11-12 and 2026-11-27.
resolution: TRUE if both the Russian Defense Ministry and the Ukrainian Coordination Headquarters for the Treatment of Prisoners of War confirm a completed exchange occurring between 2026-11-12 and 2026-11-27, as reported by Reuters or AP.
failure_condition: No prisoners were physically exchanged between Russia and Ukraine at any point between 2026-11-12 and 2026-11-27.

statement: The United States announces a suspension or lifting of its blockade on Iran between 2026-11-12 and 2026-12-15.
resolution: TRUE if the White House, Pentagon or CENTCOM announces between 2026-11-12 and 2026-12-15 that the US blockade on Iran is suspended or lifted, as reported by Reuters or AP.
failure_condition: The US blockade on Iran stayed in force with no announced suspension or lifting between 2026-11-12 and 2026-12-15.

statement: The Federal Open Market Committee lowers the federal funds target range at its scheduled meeting concluding on 2026-12-09.
resolution: TRUE if FRED series DFEDTARU shows a lower value for 2026-12-10 than for 2026-12-08.
failure_condition: The upper bound of the federal funds target range on 2026-12-10 is equal to or higher than its level on 2026-12-08.

statement: The 10-year Treasury constant maturity yield prints at or above 5.25 percent on at least one trading day between 2026-11-12 and 2026-12-11. Reference: 5.00 percent on the packet date.
resolution: TRUE if any FRED DGS10 daily observation dated between 2026-11-12 and 2026-12-11 is 5.25 or higher. Reference: 5.00 percent on the packet date.
failure_condition: Every DGS10 daily observation dated between 2026-11-12 and 2026-12-11 is below 5.25.

statement: Anthropic prices its initial public offering, evidenced by a final prospectus on Form 424B4 filed with the SEC, between 2026-11-12 and 2026-12-04.
resolution: TRUE if SEC EDGAR lists a Form 424B4 filed by Anthropic with a filing date between 2026-11-12 and 2026-12-04.
failure_condition: Anthropic did not file a Form 424B4 final prospectus with a filing date between 2026-11-12 and 2026-12-04.

statement: CISA adds a Xen Orchestra vulnerability to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog between 2026-11-12 and 2026-12-11.
resolution: TRUE if the CISA KEV catalog JSON contains an entry naming Xen Orchestra in its product or vulnerabilityName field with a dateAdded value between 2026-11-12 and 2026-12-11.
failure_condition: No Xen Orchestra vulnerability was added to the KEV catalog with a dateAdded value between 2026-11-12 and 2026-12-11.

statement: Certified Mississippi results for the 2026-11-03 US Senate general election, published between 2026-11-12 and 2026-12-18, show Scott Colom with more votes than Cindy Hyde-Smith.
resolution: TRUE if certified statewide results published by the Mississippi Secretary of State between 2026-11-12 and 2026-12-18 show Colom with a higher vote total than Hyde-Smith.
failure_condition: Certified results show Hyde-Smith with at least as many votes as Colom, or no certified statewide result for the race was published between 2026-11-12 and 2026-12-18.

statement: Pete Hegseth resigns, is dismissed, or has his departure as US Defense Secretary publicly announced between 2026-11-12 and 2026-12-31.
resolution: TRUE if the White House, the Pentagon or Hegseth publicly announces his resignation, dismissal or departure from the post between 2026-11-12 and 2026-12-31, as reported by AP or Reuters.
failure_condition: Hegseth remained in the post with no resignation, dismissal or departure announced between 2026-11-12 and 2026-12-31.

statement: Italian authorities arrest or formally charge at least one person over the email bomb threats sent to Italian schools on 2026-11-11, between 2026-11-12 and 2026-12-11.
resolution: TRUE if Italian police or prosecutors announce between 2026-11-12 and 2026-12-11 the arrest or formal charging of at least one person over the 2026-11-11 school bomb threat emails, as reported by ANSA, Reuters or AP.
failure_condition: No person was arrested or formally charged over the school bomb threat emails between 2026-11-12 and 2026-12-11.

statement: The Ebola outbreak in Kenya is officially declared over by the World Health Organization or the Kenyan Ministry of Health between 2026-11-12 and 2027-01-15.
resolution: TRUE if WHO or the Kenyan Ministry of Health issues a declaration dated between 2026-11-12 and 2027-01-15 that the Ebola outbreak in Kenya has ended, per who.int, Reuters or AP.
failure_condition: The Ebola outbreak in Kenya was not officially declared over between 2026-11-12 and 2027-01-15.
